differences: The desktop search strip still shares space with range navigation, so the right side is denser than the left on wide screens.
Mobile cards remain content-heavy because episode summaries are intentionally preserved rather than aggressively collapsed.
suggestions: If a later pass is needed, move desktop range controls to a second lighter row or reduce their width.
If mobile browsing still feels long, add an optional compact mode for summaries instead of removing search clarity.
visual_verdict.reasoning: The page now reads as a search-first episode index instead of a generic content stack. Search, quick presets, and result scanning are all materially simpler on both desktop and mobile.
next_actions: Use screenshots to gather user feedback before any second visual pass
